data.one_liner: Prompt user to pick a saved device email or phone number without extra permissions
data.what_it_does: Allows users to select an email address or phone number stored on their device. It utilizes the native Android AccountPicker API to fetch this information. No special device permissions are required.
use_when: You need to prompt the user for their email or phone number on Android
You want to avoid requesting dangerous device or account permissions
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms other than Android
You need a multi-platform solution for account picking
strengths: Does not require extra device permissions
Lightweight plugin utilizing native AccountPicker API
weaknesses: iOS support was removed in version 2.2.0
